system.description:
The Old Gods have countless names and aspects. These are the three most prominent, though many others rise and fall in the ballads of the nord poets.

The faithful worship all of the Old Gods in turn, but many find they align with one in particular. Paying respect to all the gods is not a betrayal; it is honorable.

The Old Gods often demand sacrifices and brutal suffering as a test of worth. Outsiders might see this as barbaric, but the truth is not theirs to understand.
